target: Positive gross fulfilled units: normalized completed/shipped/returned statuses. Exclude cancelled/processing and nonpositive quantity. Do not net returns or add them to usable stock.
deduplication: Remove exact duplicate rows, reject conflicting transaction IDs
population: Same supplied 336 product/store keys for every method; each has records before 2024; use all channels assigned to store
missing_dates: Build recorded-unit calendar from 2024-01-01. Fill absent pair records on globally observed dates with zero recorded fulfilled units conditional on complete reporting and active assortment. Never claim zero unconstrained demand; reject a globally missing date in training windows.
training: 2024-01-01 through each origin inclusive; candidate-specific recent windows use only trailing observations

horizons.primary: Supplier lead days plus 7 review days, 8-14 days by key

baseline: 84-calendar-day mean of recorded fulfilled units per key; analyst interpretation of a few months, not customer's proven rule

candidates.name: mean84
candidates.rationale: Fair recent-month baseline; 17k rows and 336 longstanding sparse keys in input-4.csv

candidates.name: mean28
candidates.rationale: Responsive recent level; monthly record counts in input-4.csv rise in autumn

candidates.name: croston_sba
candidates.rationale: Sparse pair sales; conventional intermittent-demand model with fixed alpha 0.1, bias adjustment, no tuning

candidates.name: poisson_seasonal
candidates.rationale: Pool month seasonality across sparse keys while retaining pair levels; input-4.csv shows repeated November/December record-count elevation in 2022-24. Monthly aggregate rates with exposure weights, pair/month one-hot plus linear time, fixed regularization alpha 0.01; no promotions or future statuses as features

primary_metric: Mean absolute error in product units per product/store coverage window, equally weighted across keys and origins
selection_rule: Lowest primary MAE. Numerical ties within 1e-8 select simpler candidate in listed order. No business meaningfulness threshold invented. Baseline may win.
secondary_diagnostics: Fit and inference CPU/wall time and process peak memory
Empirical coverage residuals; not calibrated guarantees
information_boundaries: Cut by order date at each origin, fit without later sales. Source final statuses cannot recreate historical as-of statuses; comparisons are conditional development evidence. Current policy horizons provide common scenario weights, not historical ordering rules. No December 2025 outcomes.
search_budget: Four candidates, fixed hyperparameters, one primary comparison; no iterative gain search
business_limits: Forecast error does not measure stock availability, costs, savings or incumbent superiority. No historical stock or price cost score. Selection and deployment use same lead-plus-review horizon; next-week horizon also reported.
performance_success_gate: Not satisfied: external threshold and genuinely untouched outcomes missing.
